title: Salon Launch: ₹30,000/Month Campaign Plan
story: A trendy salon in Bandra, Mumbai has a ₹30,000 monthly ad budget (₹1,000/day). Their goal is to fill weekday appointment slots for hair coloring and spa treatments. The owner is completely new to digital ads.

steps.prompt: Which campaign objective and destination should you propose?
options: Awareness objective with an Instagram feed photo
Leads objective paired with Click-to-WhatsApp so local clients can chat and confirm appointment slots
Traffic objective sending users to a 10-page generic blog
steps.explain: For high-ticket local beauty services in India, Click-to-WhatsApp allows direct consultation, timing coordination, and trust building.

steps.prompt: How should you target the audience at the Ad Set level?
options: All adults aged 18-65 across the entire state of Maharashtra
Women aged 21-45 within a 5 km radius of Bandra, interested in Hair Care, Beauty, or Broad
Men interested in gaming across Mumbai
Only people who have visited Paris
steps.explain: Local salon clients rarely travel beyond 5-7 km. Targeting local women interested in hair and beauty provides a tight, high-converting audience.

steps.prompt: Which creative strategy will yield the highest thumbstop rate and bookings?
options: A stock photo of a salon scissors with prices in tiny font
Short-form before/after hair transformation Reels featuring local clients, paired with a 'Weekday Special: 20% Off' headline
An image of the salon's trade license certificate
A 3-minute video interviewing the salon's landlord
steps.explain: Visual proof of hair transformations combined with an irresistible weekday incentive directly drives bookings.

finalQuestion: In under 80 words, summarize your media plan for the salon owner, including the expected booking volume.
keyPoints: Selected Leads via Click-to-WhatsApp for direct appointment booking
Used before/after transformation video Reels with weekday incentive
modelAnswer: We will run a Leads campaign driving directly to Click-to-WhatsApp with a daily budget of ₹1,000. We will target women aged 21-45 living within 5 km of Bandra using authentic before/after transformation Reels offering a 20% weekday special. At an estimated ₹120 CPL, this budget will generate approximately 200 customer inquiries monthly, easily hitting your target of 150 booked salon appointments.
